head_coach.name: Pape Thiaw
head_coach.play_style_summary: A proactive, offensive approach characterized by aggressive high pressing, swift transitions from defense to attack, and immediate ball recovery after possession loss, with recent tactical flexibility to adapt to a 3-4-3 system during matches.

key_players.name: Nicolas Jackson
key_players.performance_stats: Serving as a premier attacking focal point, known for dynamic movement, elite link-up play, and clinical finishes in top-tier competition.

key_players.name: Pape Matar Sarr
key_players.performance_stats: A energetic, box-to-box midfield engine returning fully fit to provide essential physical presence and distribution.

key_players.name: Iliman Ndiaye
key_players.performance_stats: Widely regarded as the team's creative heartbeat, offering exceptional dribbling, versatility, and playmaking flare.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Thigh injury sustained in mid-April, requiring specialized rehabilitation and a highly managed return to full fitness.
Hamstring injury in his right leg.
